notes.title: Patch v1.1.1
notes.content:
Update: Chest & Upgrade System + Performance Improvements

Chest is now available inside the house.

Upgrade system added: locked slots in both backpacks and chest can now be unlocked.

Performance improvements and minor bug fixes.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback and support, the demo has reached a more complete and polished state with this update. Here’s what’s new:


Quest Line Expanded
Crafting table quests are now available.

Altar quests have been added and are now accessible.

New fish stall quests have been added.


Gameplay Tweaks
Fish stall feature has been completely reworked for better flow.

The map layout has been refined to improve navigation and atmosphere.

Magic Forest mushrooms now glow slightly to make them easier to find.

General gameplay tweaks for a smoother experience.


Bug Fixes & Visual Improvements
Fixed various collision issues.

Performance improvements.

Lots of visual polish and bug fixes.



Thanks so much for playing, sharing feedback, and just being here. It really helps shape the game.
We hope you enjoy the update and there’s more to come!



If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to share your feedback on our Discord we’d love to hear from you :)

notes.title: Patch v1.0.17
notes.content:
Update: Visual Improvements & Quest Overhaul

Visuals of the Fish Stall have been improved.

The quest system has been completely reworked, paving the way for upcoming content.

General performance and visual quality improvements.

Various bugs have been fixed.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.16
notes.content:
Update: QoL Features & Critical Fixes

Players can now delete their save files directly from the game.

Hotkey slots can now be navigated using mouse scroll.

Several critical bugs have been fixed for a more stable experience.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.15
notes.content:
Update: Critical Fixes & Achievement Improvements

The new in-game achievement system has been added

Fixed a critical bug where players could fall off the boat.

Local save data is now properly separated per player.

Quest rewards now check for available inventory space before being granted.

Several other minor bugs have been resolved.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.14
notes.content:
Update: New Quests, Fixes & Stability

New quests have been added to expand your adventure.

Various bugs have been fixed to improve the experience.

General stability improvements across the game.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.13
notes.content:
Fix: Fish Selling Bug

Fixed an issue where fish placed on the stand wouldn’t sell.

Selling system now works as intended.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.12
notes.content:
Update: UX Improvements & Small Fixes

Farming and fishing interactions are now clearer and easier to follow.

Fishing can be canceled more smoothly.

Mini-game controls and feedback improved.

General UX polish across the game.

Bugs fixed.

Thanks to your feedback, we keep improving the game!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.10
notes.content:
Update: Gameplay, Visuals & RPG Improvements

Sleeping now advances the day time.

You can no longer sleep if your energy is above a certain threshold.

Funnel effects improved.

RPG dialogues and quest talks enhanced.

Design views updated.

Fixed various bugs.

Thanks to your feedback, we keep improving the game!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.7
notes.content:
Update: Story Improvements & Critical Logic Fix

We made the tutorial story flow smoother and easier to understand.

Fixed a critical issue causing game logic to malfunction on some regions and devices.

Thanks to your feedback, we keep improving the game!
